nodes.label: NASDAQ Low-Float Loophole
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: Floating a tiny fraction of equity allows mega-cap private entries to fast-track index inclusion, forcing passive ETF buying and creating explosive price actions while preserving operational control.

nodes.label: Index Systemic Risk
nodes.author: Chris Tran
nodes.rationale: A high-beta, low-float, hyper-hyped stock embedded in the NASDAQ-100 leverages passive index funds to real-world rocket telemetry, making the index vulnerable to physical/engineering failures.

nodes.label: Declarative Operating System State

nodes.author: Chris Tran

nodes.label: SSE LLM Streaming
nodes.rationale: Instead of waiting for full LLM completions, the edge Worker streams individual tokens to the client as they are generated, improving perceived response times.

nodes.label: Durable SQL Storage Pattern
nodes.rationale: Instead of holding chat history entirely in RAM or making slow external database roundtrips, the chat room's Durable Object writes directly to its own local, high-speed SQLite database file using Cloudflare's SQL Storage API.

nodes.label: Scribunto Lua Scripting
nodes.rationale: In MediaWiki, complex calculators (such as championship point standings or constructor grids) are built in Lua to parse input strings dynamically and render structured wikitext.

nodes.label: rclone Cloud Storage Mount
nodes.rationale: Mounting cloud storage drives directly to the filesystem integrates Google Drive and Microsoft 365 Business storage, providing highly resilient off-site storage for backups and media.

nodes.label: 10G/20G Bonded Network Backbone
nodes.rationale: The two hosts are interconnected via a high-speed 10 Gbps bonded connection, configured for link aggregation to achieve up to 20 Gbps of aggregate throughput.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 and D1 Edge Storage
nodes.rationale: Generated images and user-uploaded templates are stored inside Cloudflare R2 Object Storage, with their prompts, creation seeds, and dimensions cataloged in a D1 SQL Database to allow instant gallery loading and search filtering.
nodes.norm_label: cloudflare r2 and d1 edge storage

nodes.label: Multi-Broker Hedging Strategy
nodes.rationale: The backend worker uses modular adapters to talk to both Alpaca API (equities/options) and Tradovate API (futures), allowing a single agentic strategy to hedge across asset classes.

nodes.label: Shared-Domain Auto-Login
nodes.rationale: By leveraging parent domain session cookies, sYnID shares one-time authorization tokens across subdomains, instantly logging in users as they navigate between applications without redirect delays.

nodes.label: Simulation Failover Engine
nodes.rationale: If API tokens for Pingdom or StatusGator are not configured, the Cloudflare Worker seamlessly falls back to generating simulated outages so the visualizer remains functional for testing and demonstrations.

nodes.label: Dev Proxy DB Binding
nodes.rationale: The developer setup utilizes Cloudflare's Dev Proxy to dynamically bridge bindings (such as the synx-db D1 database) directly into the local Remix Vite server during development.
